displayName: voyager-crawler: a host unit keeps failing

documentation.content: A crawler systemd unit (deploy, watchdog, base backup, restore drill, the stack) failed its last run and has not succeeded for 30 min (`crawler/host_units_failed`, from `OnFailure=` + `deploy/host/unit-status.sh`). Find it with `systemctl list-units 'voyager-crawler*' --failed` and `journalctl -u <unit>`.
